title: A Study on Bias Detection and Classification in Natural Language Processing
benchmark_measurement: Hate speech and stereotype detection related to religious groups, including Islamophobia and antisemitism.
findings: Adding a religion-specific hate speech dataset (CONAN) to a broader collection of biased texts improved the model's classification performance for the 'religion' category. However, combining various datasets from different sources and with different bias types resulted in lower overall performance compared to a baseline model trained on a more homogenous dataset. The performance on the 'religion' category specifically was inconsistent across experiments.
